prompt:
Create a new concept art board for the original WHALEFALL 2D action adventure. Image 1 is ONLY canonical character identity; image 2 is the approved NEW visual language: reproduce its clean ink outlines, broad cel-painted shapes with 2-3 flat values per material, quiet blue-green gradient depth, dark foreground silhouettes and strongly readable side-view collision ledges. No realistic porous bone, no photoreal texture, no glossy 3D; use sparse hand-drawn interior lines. Main character must remain tiny Tidekeeper: round ivory diving helmet with ONE circular dark lens, short petrol teal cape, charcoal limbs, broad webbed feet, SEALED amber hip lamp, U-shaped TWO-prong resonator, coral-red tether. No horned white knight, swords, insect kingdoms, antler transit, gothic stone buildings, or borrowed game characters/UI/logos. These are underwater ORGAN spaces within one dead whale, old culture shown by shell shelters, worn sound grooves and knotted cords. Baleen ONLY in mouth, never lungs, stomach, ribs or ear. All ledges strictly same orthographic SIDE VIEW plane, no isometric or 3D perspective platforms. 16:9 landscape, no text or watermark. THREE horizontal side-by-side panels of EXACT SAME whale mouth chamber GEOMETRY at three stages of revisit. Same six platforms, same upper fixed red anchor ring, same right side pearl latch, same lower catch shelf in each. Panel1 low main route between tongue ledges, upper niche visibly unreachable, hero uses shell to divert current. Panel2 hero now has anchor tether to the preexisting ring, reaching upper path and opening reverse latch to shell camp. Panel3 returned much later with reflection ability, an existing small bivalve's intact bead goes past hero into side latch, opening tiny memory niche. Thin amber arrows for first route, teal dotted for revisit, very minimal marks, no text. Repeat hero only as action silhouette per panel. Approved clean flat ink style, muted navy/ivory, clearly readable planar topology.

LOCAL REVISION AFTER GENERATION (edit target: generated D08):
Precise tiny edit to the supplied three-panel concept sheet. Preserve every platform, hero, route arrow, shell, style and composition. In the RIGHTMOST PANEL ONLY, inside the small amber-lit reward niche at the far right, REMOVE the tiny pale skull-headed or white humanoid figurine. Replace that tiny object with a simple abstract golden spiral MEMORY PEARL resting on a flat dark stone: NO face, NO eyes, NO horns, NO body silhouette. Nothing else changes. Keep the actual teal-caped single-lens protagonist unchanged.
